contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' = 42,670.65 at the foot of the LAST continuation sheet (p4), equal to BOTH the summary's This Report and its Cumulative Total line-1 cells (42670.65)
contributions.detail: A CONTINUATION SCHEDULE over three sheets with NO per-sheet subtotal - the grand total is printed only once, at the foot of p4 - so the gate is the multi-sheet sum. p2's 23 rows sum to 30,675.40, p3's 27 rows to 11,205.25, p4's 15 rows to 790.00; 30,675.40 + 11,205.25 + 790.00 = 42,670.65, matching the printed grand total to the cent. Last Report is 0 (first report of the cycle, the convention report), so This Report and Cumulative coincide and the verdict is exact. The two INKIND rows (2,500.00 each) and the two candidate LOAN rows (13,900.00 and 10,000.00) are all inside that sum, as the filer's own total requires.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report)' = 39,873.22 (p5), against the cover's line-2 cells of 38941.83 (This Report AND Cumulative)
expenditures.detail: TRACED DELTA of exactly 931.39, retained verbatim as the FILER's arithmetic and not adjusted. The 20 Form B rows sum to 39,873.22, matching Form B's OWN printed grand total to the cent - the schedule is internally perfect. The cover's line-2 figure is 39,873.22 - 38,941.83 = 931.39 lower, and 931.39 is exactly Form B ROW 1 (1/8/2026, Weber County, Filing Fee): the filer carried the schedule forward to the cover while leaving his own county filing fee out of the summary. The cover is internally consistent with its own lower number - 42,670.65 - 38,941.83 = 3,728.82, the printed Ending Balance - which is what makes the omission traceable to that one row rather than to a transcription error: against the schedule's total the balance would have been 2,797.43. Both printed figures were re-read at 800 dpi (39,873.22 on p5, 38941.83 on the cover) and both stand. Nothing here was nudged; the itemized rows are published at the schedule's own total and the discrepancy is documented, not resolved.

notes: The 2026 county form, TYPED throughout, five pages: p1 cover ('7 days before the candidates' convention' ticked, signed 4/3/2026), FORM A running as a THREE-SHEET CONTINUATION over p2-p4 (65 entries, no per-sheet subtotal, one grand total at the foot of p4), and FORM B on p5 (20 entries, its own grand total). All four schedule pages are NATIVELY LANDSCAPE, so their geometry axis is 'y'. The cover's summary figures are printed WITHOUT thousands separators or dollar signs (42670.65 / 38941.83 / 3728.82) while the schedules use both; retained exactly as printed on each. THE ONE DISCREPANCY, traced and NOT repaired: Form B's own total is 39,873.22 but the cover states 38,941.83, a difference of exactly the 931.39 Weber County filing fee on Form B row 1 - see recon.expenditures. The contributions side has no such issue and closes to the cent. Donor STREET addresses on every Form A row are BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (government-applied redaction, preserved); the city/state beside each bar survive and are what donor_city/donor_state carry - EXCEPT on p2 row 1, where the bar covers the whole address block, so that row's city/state are blank for a redaction reason, not a filer reason. The candidate's own street address and City/Zip on p1 are redacted the same way. SCANNED, not a Polimorphic e-filing: no text layer over any of the five pages and no Polimorphic footer. Per the wave brief this filer also has a 2026-07-23 re-file that supersedes an original; this document (the 4/3/2026 convention report) is transcribed on its own terms and is not merged with any other.
